claim: Let \(Q_3\) be the one-dimensional cubical graph on \(\{0,1\}^3\), with edges at Hamming distance one, and let \(\mathcal M(Q_3)\) be its ordinary Morse complex whose simplices are compatible acyclic vertex-edge incidence matchings. Its complete integral homotopy type is \[\mathcal M(Q_3)\simeq\bigvee^{4}S^{5}\vee\bigvee^{139}S^{6}.\] This exact homotopy classification upgrades the previously calculated mod-two Betti numbers to an integral torsion-free sphere-wedge theorem. The claim is restricted to this finite graph and its ordinary Morse complex, not the distinct ordinary graph matching complex.
integrity: Two exact independent face enumerations, full matched-Hasse acyclicity verification, signed integral Morse differential, and unimodular unit-pivot elimination with zero residual block; standalone Python checker embedded.
scientific_limitations: One finite 3-cube ordinary Morse complex only. The previously known mod-two result is not new. No integral equivariant or higher-dimensional-cube classification; full text of relevant Cayley-directed-forest thesis unavailable.
title: Integral homotopy type of the cube graph Morse complex
